update.releaseNotes:
v5.10.41 - Turn-adaptive risk tolerance, a real bug fix, and 3 more gaps closed
Fixed ----- - Genuine failures were being reported as a successful "manually stopped" run: a session error, running out of alarm clocks, an invalid scenario, and hitting a dialog flagged dangerous because it risks a real-world purchase all threw the same exception type as a normal user-initiated stop, so the bot's main loop rebranded every one of them as a green success notification instead of an error. Now correctly distinguished and reported.
Added ----- - Turn-Adaptive Risk Tolerance (Training Settings, under Risky Training): the risky-training failure-chance ceiling can now taper from a looser value at turn 1 down to the existing ceiling by turn 72, instead of using the same threshold for the whole 75-turn run. A bad training result early has many turns left to recover from; the same result late in the run doesn't. - Decision Reports now include a real settings snapshot for every scenario. Previously only Trackblazer's reports showed the mood/energy/failure-chance/risky-training/auto-abandon settings that were active - URA Finale, Unity Cup, and Grand Live reports had an empty settings section. - Connection Error Retry (Settings, under Wait Delay): the max retry attempts and cooldown for the in-game connection-error dialog are now sliders instead of fixed values, for users on flaky Wi-Fi/emulators. - A one-time Discord warning now fires if the bot can't tap Start Career after repeated attempts, instead of silently retrying forever with no visibility.
